description: Ulam spectral gap analysis for Pomeau-Manneville intermittency maps
function: Pomeau-Manneville type-I map, Ulam transition matrix, spectral gap computation, log-log regression for kappa scaling exponent
inputs: alpha_grid: sequence of float alpha values
outputs: pm_map: np.ndarray of mapped values in [0,1)
run_pipeline: Dict with alphas, gaps, regression results, fail-closed status

public_api.name: KAPPA_THEORY
public_api.description: Theoretical universality exponent kappa = 2/(2-beta) ≈ 1.667 for beta=0.75

public_api.name: MIN_GAP
public_api.description: Minimum spectral gap threshold for regression inclusion

public_api.name: N_VALID_MIN
public_api.description: Minimum number of valid gap points required for regression

public_api.name: pm_map
public_api.signature: pm_map(x: np.ndarray, alpha: float, beta: float = BETA_PM) -> np.ndarray
public_api.description: Vectorized Pomeau-Manneville type-I intermittency map. Left branch: x + alpha*x^(1+beta) mod 1; right branch: 2x - 1

public_api.name: ulam_matrix
public_api.signature: ulam_matrix(alpha: float, n_bins=80, n_traj=80_000, seed=42, beta=BETA_PM) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict]
public_api.description: Build row-stochastic Ulam transition matrix for the PM map

public_api.name: canonical_gap
public_api.signature: canonical_gap(P: np.ndarray, diag: Dict) -> Tuple[Optional[float], Dict]
public_api.description: Compute spectral gap Delta = 1 - |lambda_2| with fail-closed guards

public_api.name: compute_gap_point
public_api.signature: compute_gap_point(alpha: float, n_bins=80, n_traj=80_000, seed=42, beta=BETA_PM) -> Tuple[Optional[float], Dict]
public_api.description: Compute single (alpha -> gap) point with diagnostics

public_api.name: loglog_regression
public_api.description: Fit log Delta = c + kappa*log alpha and return kappa_fit, R2, RMS_resid, stderr_kappa, CI95_kappa, qualificatif

public_api.name: run_pipeline
public_api.signature: run_pipeline(alpha_grid, n_bins=80, n_traj=80_000, seed=42, beta=BETA_PM, min_gap=MIN_GAP) -> Dict
public_api.description: Run the full Ulam spectral gap pipeline over an alpha grid
